decision_timing: frozen before semantic label generation, independent confirmation sampling, Phase 4 training, and TEST evaluation

semantic_scoring_configuration.relationship: unchanged selected model, revision, claim segmentation, NLI thresholds, aggregation, float32 inference, and context handling

semantic_unevaluable_policy.rule: If any reference-answer claim produced by the frozen deterministic claim-segmentation procedure exceeds the selected NLI model's valid pair-input budget, every retrieval condition for that question is semantic-unevaluable.
semantic_unevaluable_policy.scope: mechanically applied to every matching question, without question-ID-specific exceptions

rationale: Introducing new segmentation after model and threshold selection would change the frozen semantic procedure.
An explicit missing semantic target and exclusion preserves methodological integrity.
The affected population is small and is reported transparently.
